app.name: Creality 3D printer
app.summary: How your Creality printer's print goes, its temperatures and camera, and keys to pause, resume and stop.
app.camera_example: The printer's camera, with the progress under it
app.status_hint: The integration's Print Status sensor (sensor.<printer>_print_status): the state, the file, the progress and the time left.
app.live_hint: Stream the camera live on a screen that can (the ESP32-P4 boards). Other screens show a picture that refreshes.
app.nozzle_hint: The printer's temperature sensors (Nozzle Temperature, Bed Temperature, Chamber Temperature). Leave one empty to leave it out.
app.layer_hint: The Working Layer and Total Layers sensors, for "Layer 126 of 300".
app.light_hint: The printer's light, for a key on the control card.
app.buttons_hint: The integration's Pause Print, Resume Print and Stop Print buttons, for the keys of the control card.
